name: Rarity
source:
A unicorn pony with a pure white body, dark blue eyes and a royal purple mane and tail which are combed in wavy curls most of time. 

She is a fashion designer and seamstress at her own dressmaking shop, the Carousel Boutique. She is very stylish and beautiful, takes great interest in fashion and clothing design, and often tries to make herself the center of attention. She considers herself a proper lady and often acts in a sophisticated manner and can also be dramatic and histrionic. 

Rarity is [url=/c11586]Sweetie Belle[/url]'s older sister, and often takes care of her when her parents are away. She represents the Element of Generosity.
